payload.claim: saffron/cell/session.py is in touches, matching the 'raises the risk tier' path list (saffron/cell/**), while the spec declares risk: standard. This is not a defect: DESIGN.md documents that effective_risk auto-elevates to elevated whenever a changed path matches policy.elevate_on (which lists saffron/cell/** for this repo) regardless of the spec's declared risk field, and tasks.risk is documented as holding only the declared tier, separate from the earned/effective tier. The real cell building this spec will run at elevated for its own diff even though the frontmatter says standard, which is the intended mechanism, not an error. A reader skimming only the frontmatter could be misled about the sensitivity of the change.
